summary_1line: Story of King Uparichara Vasu, the miraculous birth of Satyavati and Vyasa, and the divine events leading to the compiler of the Mahabharata.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Uparichara Vasu rides a crystal chariot through the sky while Gandharvas and Apsaras gather around him in the air.
Two hawks fight midair over the Yamuna, dropping the king’s seed into the river where a great fish waits below.
The sage Parasara surrounds the riverboat in sudden mystical fog as Satyavati stands blushing on the Yamuna.
